theme.en: AI hardware supply chains are being redrawn

dek.en: Reported Chinese DUV production, an Arizona-made GB300 milestone, and new accelerator economics point to a more regionalized AI hardware stack. The remaining constraints extend beyond wafers to packaging, memory, and power delivery.
dek.zh: 中国国产DUV量产的报道、亚利桑那制造GB300的里程碑和新的加速器经济性，都显示AI硬件栈正趋向区域化。剩余的约束已从晶圆延伸至封装、存储和供电。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AMD positions Helios racks on tokens per dollar
title.zh: AMD以每美元Token产出定位Helios机架

summary.en: AMD unveiled new data-center GPU systems at Advancing AI and said its Helios racks deliver 30% more tokens per dollar than comparable Nvidia systems. The claim shifts the comparison from peak accelerator specifications to delivered inference economics, where rack integration, networking, and software all matter.
summary.zh: AMD在Advancing AI活动上发布新的数据中心GPU系统，并称其Helios机架的每美元Token产出比可比Nvidia系统高30%。这一主张将比较重点从加速器峰值规格转向实际推理经济性，机架集成、网络与软件都将成为关键。

title.en: Report says Google's Frozen V2 TPU puts SRAM on-die
title.zh: 报道称Google的Frozen V2 TPU将SRAM集成到芯片上

summary.en: A report cited by Wccftech says Google is considering a Frozen V2 TPU that integrates SRAM on silicon and reduces dependence on TSMC's CoWoS packaging for Gemini workloads. The design is unconfirmed, but it illustrates why hyperscalers may exchange packaging complexity for chip-level memory integration and different cost-power trade-offs.
summary.zh: Wccftech援引的报道称，Google正考虑一种Frozen V2 TPU，将SRAM集成到芯片上，以降低Gemini工作负载对TSMC CoWoS封装的依赖。该设计尚未确认，但它说明超大规模云厂商为何可能以芯片级存储集成换取封装复杂度下降及不同的成本—功耗取舍。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Report: TSMC Arizona fabricates GB300 GPUs, packaging stays in Taiwan
title.zh: 报道称TSMC亚利桑那厂制造GB300 GPU，封装仍在台湾进行

summary.en: Wccftech, citing Commercial Times, reports that TSMC has fabricated some Nvidia GB300 AI GPUs on its 4nm process at Arizona Fab 21. The chips reportedly still travel to Taiwan for advanced packaging, showing that US wafer production does not yet make the accelerator supply chain domestic end to end.
summary.zh: Wccftech援引Commercial Times报道称，TSMC已在亚利桑那Fab 21采用4nm工艺制造部分Nvidia GB300 AI GPU。据称这些芯片仍需运往台湾进行先进封装，说明美国晶圆制造尚未使加速器供应链实现端到端本土化。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: China distributor price moves lift RTX 50-series GPU prices
title.zh: 中国渠道调价推高RTX 50系列GPU价格

summary.en: MSI and Colorful raised prices for Nvidia's RTX 50-series cards in China, with the article describing increases of up to 59% across the range and as much as 75% over MSRP at the top end. Broad changes in board pricing can signal pressure in GPU, memory, and channel costs, though consumer-card pricing remains a noisy supply indicator.
summary.zh: MSI与七彩虹上调了Nvidia RTX 50系列显卡在中国的价格；报道指全系列涨幅最高达59%，顶级型号较建议零售价最高高出75%。板卡价格的大范围变化可能反映GPU、存储与渠道成本压力，但消费级显卡价格仍是带有噪声的供给指标。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Report: China starts producing domestic immersion DUV tools
title.zh: 报道称中国开始生产国产浸没式DUV设备

summary.en: Tom's Hardware reports that a Shanghai state-backed company has begun mass production of immersion DUV lithography machines and plans first deliveries this year to SMIC, Hua Hong, and CXMT. If confirmed, it would advance substitution of restricted lithography equipment, but it does not imply a domestic EUV capability; process qualification will determine its manufacturing impact.
summary.zh: Tom's Hardware报道称，一家上海国资背景企业已开始量产浸没式DUV光刻机，并计划今年向SMIC、华虹和CXMT交付首批设备。若获证实，这将推动受限光刻设备的替代，但不代表已具备国产EUV能力；工艺验证将决定其制造影响。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: South Korea's $518 billion semiconductor push focuses attention on capacity policy
title.zh: 韩国5180亿美元半导体计划聚焦产能政策

summary.en: Foley & Lardner examines South Korea's $518 billion semiconductor investment push and its implications for global technology companies. The scale reinforces how governments are using policy to secure domestic production, memory leadership, and AI infrastructure; the test is whether incentives become usable power, water, talent, and fab capacity.
summary.zh: Foley & Lardner分析了韩国5180亿美元半导体投资计划及其对全球科技公司的影响。该计划的规模表明各国正以政策保障本土生产、存储领先地位和AI基础设施；检验标准是激励能否转化为可用的电力、用水、人才与晶圆厂产能。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 挑战者

title.en: Lattice completes $1.6 billion acquisition of AMI
title.zh: Lattice完成16亿美元收购AMI

summary.en: Lattice Semiconductor has completed its $1.6 billion acquisition of AMI, according to The Business Journals. The deal broadens Lattice's AI data-center infrastructure platform beyond programmable logic into adjacent system-management capabilities, with integration determining the potential for cross-selling.
summary.zh: 据The Business Journals报道，Lattice Semiconductor已完成对AMI的16亿美元收购。该交易扩大了Lattice的AI数据中心基础设施平台，使其从可编程逻辑延伸到相邻的系统管理能力；整合效果将决定交叉销售潜力。

theme.en: Making AI hardware more efficient and verifiable
theme.zh: 让AI硬件更高效、更可验证

dek.en: This week's papers pair inference and memory-efficiency techniques with tools for building and validating hardware. Their common goal is to turn algorithmic flexibility into predictable behavior on real architectures.
dek.zh: 本周论文一方面探索推理与存储效率，另一方面改进硬件构建和验证工具。共同目标是将算法灵活性转化为真实架构上可预测的行为。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Task-conditional compute skipping for multi-task inference accelerators
title.zh: 面向多任务推理加速器的任务条件计算跳过

papers.authors: Afzal Ahmad, Gaoyu Mao, et al.

summary.en: Sparse by Command uses the task command available before inference to predict hardware-aligned tile masks, letting a multi-task accelerator skip irrelevant work. It co-designs training, an ISA carrying tile bitmasks, and a scheduler, but real gains will depend on task mix and gate accuracy.
summary.zh: Sparse by Command利用推理前已知的任务指令预测与硬件对齐的Tile掩码，使多任务加速器跳过无关计算。它协同设计训练、携带Tile位掩码的ISA和调度器，但实际收益仍取决于任务组合与门控准确性。

title.en: RED-PIM reduces Transformer attention data movement
title.zh: RED-PIM降低Transformer注意力的数据搬运

summary.en: RED-PIM reorganizes Transformer attention for processing-in-memory so inter-bank movement falls from O(N²) to O(N), while intermediate matrices shrink from N×N to d×d. It targets a scaling weakness in prior PIM attention designs, although bank capacity and mapping overhead will determine practical benefits.
summary.zh: RED-PIM为存内计算重组Transformer注意力计算，使跨Bank数据移动从O(N²)降至O(N)，中间矩阵从N×N缩小到d×d。它针对先前PIM注意力设计的扩展性弱点，但Bank容量和映射开销将决定实际收益。

title.en: AI Inference Systems
title.zh: AI推理系统

title.en: Unified static and dynamic pruning for GPU LLM inference
title.zh: 用于GPU LLM推理的静态—动态统一剪枝

papers.authors: Jinhyeok Kim, Yejoon Lee, Jaeyoung Do

summary.en: SPDP combines permanently pruned weights with input-adaptive activation skipping for LLM inference on GPUs. Its tiled bitmap format and separate CUDA-core and Tensor-Core kernels confront the metadata and irregular-access costs that have limited earlier sparse designs.
summary.zh: SPDP将永久权重剪枝与输入自适应激活跳过结合，用于GPU上的LLM推理。其分块位图格式和独立的CUDA Core、Tensor Core内核，直接应对限制早期稀疏设计的元数据和不规则访问成本。

title.en: Circuits & Reliability
title.zh: 电路与可靠性

title.en: Warp divergence from Pascal through Blackwell
title.zh: 从Pascal到Blackwell的Warp分歧特性

summary.en: This microbenchmark study finds that divergent GPU paths serialize roughly linearly with path count from Pascal through Blackwell, while warp efficiency falls as 32/k. It separates that stable programmer-visible cost model from changes in compiler reconvergence machinery, though the evidence comes from controlled kernels rather than full applications.
summary.zh: 这项微基准研究发现，从Pascal到Blackwell，GPU分歧路径的串行化时间大致随路径数线性增长，Warp效率则按32/k下降。它将稳定的程序员可见成本模型与编译器汇合机制变化区分开来，但证据来自受控内核而非完整应用。

title.en: Distributed delay-based BIST for flexible mixed-signal circuits
title.zh: 用于柔性混合信号电路的分布式延迟BIST

papers.authors: Paula Carolina Lozano Duarte, Sule Ozev, et al.

summary.en: The authors embed lightweight digital BIST into ring-oscillator stages for IGZO-TFT flexible electronics. They report 93% individual-defect coverage, 88% multiple-defect coverage, and 3% power overhead, addressing test constraints where external equipment and pins are scarce.
summary.zh: 作者将轻量级数字BIST嵌入IGZO-TFT柔性电子的环形振荡器级中。他们报告单个缺陷覆盖率93%、多个缺陷覆盖率88%、功耗开销3%，面向外部测试设备和引脚稀缺的测试约束。

title.en: EDA & Design Verification
title.zh: EDA与设计验证

title.en: CircuitWeave aligns schematics and specifications for executable RTL
title.zh: CircuitWeave对齐原理图与规格以生成可执行RTL

papers.authors: Jiahao Feng, Haiyan Qin, et al.

summary.en: CircuitWeave separates a schematic-derived topology contract from a text-derived behavior contract before generating RTL. Its 5,000-package dataset and explicit fusion aim to surface missing or conflicting evidence, a key failure mode in multimodal RTL generation that merits broader testing on human specifications.
summary.zh: CircuitWeave在生成RTL前，先分离由原理图得到的拓扑契约和由文本得到的行为契约。其包含5000个软件包的数据集及显式融合机制旨在暴露缺失或冲突证据，这一多模态RTL生成的关键失败模式仍需在人工规格上更广泛测试。

title.en: AlphaRoute uses LLMs to tune multi-objective global routing
title.zh: AlphaRoute使用LLM调优多目标全局布线

papers.authors: Kabir Murjani, Mishri Bhavsar, et al.

summary.en: AlphaRoute combines deterministic routing tools with LLM policy optimization to adapt congestion penalties during rip-up and reroute. On selected ISPD 2025 benchmarks it reports a 98.6% overflow reduction on MEMPOOL, though results need replication across designs and clear accounting of inference cost and determinism.
summary.zh: AlphaRoute将确定性布线工具与LLM策略优化结合，在拆线重布过程中自适应调整拥塞惩罚。在选定的ISPD 2025基准上，它报告MEMPOOL溢出减少98.6%，但仍需在更多设计上复现，并清楚核算推理成本与确定性。
